title: US user facility reporting: when a report is owed, to whom, and by when
plain: A death or serious injury the device caused or contributed to: a user facility reports in 10 work days. No malfunction reports.
law_in_force_from: 21 CFR Part 803 as in force at awareness (for your consultant to confirm)

change.reason: B9 Part C (B9-D11): the user facility's floor, questions 1 to 3 reused from US-floor-1, 10 work days, no malfunction.

review.note: Starter, for your consultant to confirm.

approval.note: B9 spec approved 11 Nov 2026 (B9-D8, D10, D11, D12): role floors, starter, from the start.

question_set.title: US user facility reporting (21 CFR 803.30)
question_set.note: Questions 1 to 3 of the manufacturer's set, word for word. Questions 4 to 6 are not asked: user facilities do not report malfunctions. Whether question 3's wording matches 803.30's test is to confirm with your consultant.

notes.text: User facility report: 10 work days (21 CFR 803.30). A death goes to FDA and the manufacturer; a serious injury to the manufacturer, or to FDA when the manufacturer is unknown. User facilities do not report malfunctions. Starter rule, for your consultant to confirm.
An Unknown answer could make the event reportable: the suggestion stays pending information, and "not reportable" cannot be concluded until it is answered.

folding.why: Not asked: no death and no serious injury

counting.words: from the day after awareness; US Eastern time or yours, whichever ends first

provisional.ruled_out: the role has one report period
